blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Online 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs a scene during capture: each keyframe spawns primitives once and refines them for only a few dozen iterations, leaving little chance to fix poor initialization or missing detail. Gaussians are also inherently soft, needing many overlaps for solid surfaces. We present Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting (HIBS), which brings beta kernels to incremental reconstruction. Their shape parameter interpolates between a soft, Gaussian-like profile and a flat-topped, near-opaque surfel, acting as a confidence dial for geometry. Our confidence-aware spawning uses geometric observability and multi-view depth agreement to initialize both opacity and shape, producing solid primitives where geometry is verifiable and soft, correctable primitives where it is not. As online densification, error-driven relocation recycles stale primitives into photometric-error hotspots. Bounded beta kernel support enables exact tile culling and faster rasterization, and a closed-form, shape-preserving merging formulation provides a level-of-detail (LOD) hierarchy for fast optimization and real-time rendering. On Mip-NeRF 360 in the on-the-fly protocol, HIBS improves PSNR by up to 0.8 dB while reducing optimization time by up to 40%. Project page: https://linus-franke.com/hibs/
blocks.zh: Online 3D Gaussian Splating在捕捉时重建了一个场景:每个键框一次地产出原始人,并且只精炼了几十个迭代,使得修复不良初始化或缺失细节的机会很少. 高斯人也具有内在的柔软性,对于固体表面需要许多重叠. 我们提出分级增生Beta Platting(HIBS),它为增生重建带来了β内核. 他们的形状参数介于柔软的,高斯式的剖面和扁平的,接近不平的冲浪器之间,起到几何的置信拨号作用. 我们的自信意识产卵利用几何可观察性和多视深度协议来初始化不透明与形状,产生固态原始物,其中几何物可核查,而软性,可矫正的原始物则不在. 作为在线密度化,错误驱动的迁移将 stale原始物回收到光度-error热点. 捆绑的β内核支持使得精确的瓦片凝聚和更快的光栅化得以实现,封闭式的,保形的结合配体为快速优化和实时渲染提供了细微分级(LOD). 在飞行协议中的Mip-NERF 360上,HIBS改进了PSNR,最高可达0.8 dB,同时将优化时间缩短至40%. 项目网页:https://linus-franke.com/hibs/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 26 ] has made high-quality radiance-field capture practical, but the standard pipeline is offline: images are collected, poses are recovered by structure-from-motion [ 51 ] , and the scene is optimized for tens of thousands of iterations.
Recent work instead reconstructs during capture [ 42 , 39 , 25 ] , providing immediate feedback and reducing the delay from capture to observable reconstruction to seconds.
We target this online regime by reconsidering the primitive itself.
blocks.zh:
3D高斯平板机(3DGS) [26] 使高斯平板机的高质量光圈-场捕捉实用,但标准管线已下线:图像被采集出,姿势被结构-自动取回[51],场景被优化为数以万计的迭代.
最近的工作反而在捕捉过程中重建了[42,39,25],提供即时反馈,并把从捕捉到可观察到的重建的延迟缩短到秒.
我们的目标是这个网络政权,重新考虑原始人本身。

blocks.en:
Online reconstruction inverts the assumptions of offline 3DGS.
Each incoming image is registered as a keyframe , spawns new primitives once , and is optimized only for a short burst before the next keyframe arrives.
This leaves little room for gradient-driven clone/split densification, opacity resets, or long optimization schedules to repair poorly initialized primitives.
In practice, what spawning produces is largely what the model keeps.
The critical decisions— what to place and how much to trust it —must therefore be made at initialization from measurable evidence.
blocks.zh:
在线重建颠倒了下行3DGS的假设.
每一个传入的图像被注册为键框, 产出一次新的原始人,
这为梯度驱动的克隆人/分化密度,不透明重排,或修复初始化差的原始人的长长优化时间表留下了很小的空间.
在实践中,产卵主要是模型所保持的。
因此,必须在从可衡量的证据中初始化时作出关键决定,即作出什么决定和如何相信它。

blocks.en:
We argue that under these constraints the primitive itself can be improved, and that the Gaussian is suboptimal.
A Gaussian is fully opaque only at its center and translucent elsewhere; representing a solid surface therefore requires overlapping many Gaussians, together with the densification and long optimization that offline 3DGS can afford.
Without this machinery, online reconstruction must spawn translucent Gaussians and hope a short optimization burst can arrange them correctly.
blocks.zh:
我们主张,在这些限制下,原始人本身可以被改进,而高斯人则是次优.
高斯人完全不透明,只在它的中心,在其他地方是半透明的;因此,代表固体地表需要许多高斯人重叠,再加上离线3DGS能够承受的密度和长时间优化.
没有这种机器,在线重建必须产生半透明高斯人,希望短暂的优化爆发能够正确安排.

blocks.en:
We instead use the beta kernel [ 36 ] , whose bounded profile has a learnable shape parameter b b that continuously interpolates between a Gaussian-like volume and a flat-topped, near-opaque surfel.
A single beta primitive can thus be a flat-topped surface patch while retaining a soft representation for uncertain geometry, thin structures, or volume.
blocks.zh:
我们使用β内核 [36], 其边框配置有一个可学习的形状参数bb, 连续地插入一个高斯等体积和一个平地,近不平地的冲浪。
因此,单一β原始物可以是平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平

blocks.en:
While Deformable Beta Splatting [ 36 ] uses this parameter offline as a compactness degree of freedom learned over long optimization schedules, we use it from geometric evidence as a confidence axis .
The key question is therefore not only how to optimize the shape, but whether the available evidence justifies treating a primitive as a solid surface.
blocks.zh:
虽然可变形 Beta Splateting [36] 使用这个参数离线,作为超长优化时间表所学出的自由的紧凑度,但我们使用从几何证据中得出的自由度作为置信轴。
因此,关键问题不仅在于如何优化外形,而且在于现有证据是否证明将原始地表视为固体地表是合理的.

blocks.en:
That evidence must be geometric, not merely photometric.
Naively spawning solid kernels is harmful: a compact, near-opaque primitive at the wrong depth blocks transmittance and suppresses gradients behind it.
Conversely, a low photometric error does not guarantee correct geometry.
When the triangulation baseline is small relative to depth, many depths explain the observed views similarly well, yet only a narrow range remains consistent under parallax.
blocks.zh:
这些证据必须是几何的,而不仅仅是光度。
自然地产出固体内核是有害的:一个紧凑的,在错误的深度块上相近的原始地层来传递并抑制其后方的梯度.
相反地,低光度误差并不能保证正确的几何.
当三角基线相对于深度较小时,许多深度也同样很好地解释了所观测到的观点,然而在平面下只有狭长的范围仍然一致.

blocks.en:
We therefore use the beta shape parameter as a confidence dial .
Confidence-aware spawning combines two independent geometric cues, Multi-view stereo (MVS) agreement with an aligned monocular prior and depth observability, to initialize each primitive along this soft-to-solid axis: well-constrained candidates are spawned solid, while ambiguous ones remain soft and correctable.
As additional views arrive, a lifetime controller updates the same parameter from accumulated multi-view evidence, progressively turning confirmed geometric confidence into solidity.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们使用β形状参数作为信心拨号。
信心意识产卵结合了两个独立的几何提示,多视立体(MVS)协议与一个对齐的单相前和深度可观察性,沿着这个软相至固相轴来初始化每个原始:受好约束的考生被产出固体,而模棱两可的考生则保持软相并可以纠正.
随着其他观点的到来,一个寿命控制器从所积累的多视图证据中更新了相同的参数,逐渐将已确认的几何自信转化为固态.

blocks.en:
To compensate for the absence of offline densification, we introduce error-driven relocation .
Near-dead primitives are recycled into photometric-error hotspots, where render-preserving copies provide additional capacity precisely where the current model is deficient.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补没有离线密度,我们引入了错误驱动的迁移。
近死原始物被再生为光度-过热地,在目前模型有缺陷的地方,渲染保存副本提供了额外的容量.

blocks.en:
The beta representation is also performant.
Its bounded support yields an exact tile-culling bound and faster rasterization, while its closed-form moments enable a shape-aware level-of-detail hierarchy for large captures.
blocks.zh:
β代表也具有活性.
其有界支撑产生精确的瓦片相接并更快地被光栅化,而其闭合形式瞬间则能为大型捕捉器提供能分辨出形状的分级.

blocks.en:
Together, these components yield an online reconstruction system in which the primitive is adapted to the short optimization horizon rather than relying on offline densification to compensate for it.
Our experiments show improved reconstruction quality and efficiency across online, benchmark, and large-scale captures.
blocks.zh:
这些组件一起产生一个在线重建系统,其中原始体被适应了短暂的优化地平线,而不是依赖离线密度来补偿.
我们的实验显示,整个在线、基准和大规模捕获的重建质量和效率得到了提高。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • We identify the Gaussian primitive as suboptimal in the spawn-once, optimize-briefly regime and adopt the beta kernel as a confidence-adaptive online primitive whose shape ranges from soft to solid. • We introduce confidence-aware spawning , which initializes opacity and shape from independent depth agreement and geometric observability. • We introduce error-driven relocation , a render-preserving online alternative to clone/split densification that recycles near-dead primitives into photometric-error hotspots. • We derive a closed-form merge for beta primitives, preserving their shape statistics and enabling a level-of-detail hierarchy for large-scale reconstruction. • We develop a fast beta rasterizer with a shape-correct culling bound that exploits the kernel’s compact support.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的贡献是: 我们确定高斯人原始在产卵-once中为次优等,优化-蝶制度,并采用β内核作为可置信适应的在线原始,其形状从软到固. ^ 我们引入了信心意识产卵法,它从独立深度协议和几何可观察性中初始化了不透明性和形状。 我们引入了由错误驱动的迁移,作为克隆/分解的在线替代物,将近死原始人回收到光度测定-更热点。 我们为β原始人得出了封闭式的合并,保留了它们的形状统计,并且为大规模重建提供了详细等级。 我们开发出一种快速的β光栅,其外形正确接合利用内核的紧凑支持。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Overview of our pipeline. An RGB stream is registered with camera parameters estimated online [ 40 ] .
Each keyframe spawns beta primitives using geometric observability and depth agreement, keeping uncertain primitives soft.
Near-dead primitives are relocated to high-error regions, followed by a short 30-iteration optimization burst with our fused rasterizer.
Periodically, small-footprint primitives are merged hierarchically using closed-form moment matching that preserves their solidity.
blocks.zh:
图2:我们管道概况。 RGB流被注册,有相机参数估计在线 [40].
每个键框会用几何可观察性和深度协议来产出β原始人,使不确定的原始人保持柔和.
近死原始人被迁移到高活度地区, 之后短短的30-穿透优化 与我们的引信光栅喷发器爆发。
周期性地,小脚印原始人采用封闭式瞬间相配来进行分级合并,以保持其固态.

blocks.en:
Neural Radiance Fields [ 43 , 3 ] synthesize photorealistic novel views from posed images, but volumetric rendering remains computationally expensive.
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 26 ] instead enables efficient rasterization and fast optimization.
Subsequent work improves compositing and rendering fidelity [ 56 , 47 , 13 ] and scales to large scenes with hierarchical representations such as Hierarchical 3DGS [ 27 ] and Octree-GS [ 48 ] .
These methods are predominantly offline, relying on precomputed poses and long optimization schedules, whereas we target reconstruction during capture.
blocks.zh:
神经辐射场 [43, 3] 从所展示的图像中合成出相片现实主义的新观点,但体积渲染仍然在计算上昂贵.
取而代之的是3D高斯平板化(3DGS)[26]能实现高效光栅化和快速优化.
随后的作品改进了相容性,使忠贞性 [56,47,13] 和有分级代表的大小场景,如分级3DGS [27]和Octree-GS [48].
这些方法主要是离线的,依靠预先计算过的姿势和长期优化的时间表,而我们的目标是在捕捉时进行重建。

blocks.en:
A range of systems reconstruct 3DGS maps incrementally from video, including SLAM-based methods [ 39 , 25 , 21 , 45 , 58 , 19 , 4 ] and joint pose-and-reconstruction approaches [ 10 , 32 ] .
SLAM methods spend far more per keyframe, e.g., hundreds of mapping iterations, densification, and long final refinement [ 39 , 58 ] .
Feed-forward and hybrid methods [ 23 , 33 , 31 , 30 ] trade scene-specific optimization for speed, typically at reduced fidelity.
Closest to our setting, On-the-Fly NVS [ 42 ] and i3DGS [ 40 ] reconstruct image streams with short optimization bursts and no densification, using learned matching and hierarchical structures.
However, these methods retain the Gaussian and spawn it once per view.
Our work instead revisits the primitive itself, introducing a controllable notion of solidity specifically for this short-burst regime.
blocks.zh:
一系列系统从视频中逐步重建了3DGS地图,包括基于SLAM的方法[39,25,21,45,58,19,4]和联合造型与重建方法[10,32].
SLAM方法每个键框花费的要多得多,例如:成百上千的绘图迭代,密度,以及长时间的最终改进[39,58].
feed-forward and mixed methods [23, 33, 31, 30] 贸易场景特异性优化速度,一般为降低忠诚度.
最接近我们的设置,On-the-Fly NVS [42]和i3DGS [40] 重建了图像流,短优化出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出
然而,这些方法保留了高斯琴并每取景一次产出.
相反,我们的工作是重新审视原始本身,为这个短暂的政权引入了一个可控制的固态概念。

blocks.en:
Alternative splatting primitives have been proposed to improve compactness, surface accuracy, or geometric fidelity, including generalized and radial kernels [ 14 , 22 ] , planar Gaussians [ 20 ] , point sprites [ 50 , 2 , 16 ] , linear and convex primitives [ 53 , 18 ] , volumetric ellipsoids [ 37 ] , and trilinear splats [ 9 ] .
Deformable radial kernels [ 22 ] are flexible, but planar and without closed-form moments, which our spawning and merge rely on.
Most closely related, Deformable Beta Splatting (DBS) [ 36 , 35 ] introduces a bounded beta kernel with a learnable shape parameter spanning Gaussian-like and surfel-like profiles.
DBS learns this shape offline together with densification; we instead initialize it from geometric evidence and update it online throughout.
blocks.zh:
提出了可替代的镀层原始物来提高收缩性,地表精度,或几何忠诚度,包括通性内核和射线内核[14,22],平面高斯克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克
可变形的光圈内核[22]是灵活的,但是有计划,没有闭合的形式瞬间,我们产卵和合并所依赖的.
最密切相关的,可变形β平板(DBS) [36,35]引入了有可学习形状参数的有边框的β内核,它跨越了高斯式和表面式的剖面.
DBS学习了这种外形 和密度; 我们从几何证据中初始化, 并在网上更新。

blocks.en:
3DGS densification has been refined through error- and gradient-based splitting, budget-aware pruning, and MCMC-based relocation [ 49 , 57 , 7 , 28 ] .
In particular, 3DGS-MCMC [ 28 ] reuses low-opacity primitives by relocating them onto live ones with render-preserving corrections.
These techniques assume long offline optimization and periodic densification, whereas our online setting has neither.
We adapt relocation to this regime by recycling near-dead primitives and targeting them using attributed photometric error.
blocks.zh:
3DGS密度通过基于误差和梯度的分拆、意识到预算的分流和基于MCMC的迁移[49、57、7、28]得到完善。
特别是,3DGS-MCMC[28]通过将低不透明原始人迁移到活生生的原生人身上,并进行保留修正。
这些技术假设长期离线优化和定期变密,而我们的在线设置也没有。
我们通过回收接近死亡的原始人并使用可归属的光度误差瞄准他们,使迁移适应这种制度。

blocks.en:
Recent work accelerates 3DGS through improved backward passes, gradient reduction, tighter tile bounds, and fused optimization [ 38 , 6 , 47 , 15 , 12 ] .
We build on these ideas for the online burst, but derive the rasterization bounds for the bounded beta kernel.
In particular, the Gaussian cutoff is not valid for low-opacity solid kernels, making the beta-specific bound a correctness requirement in addition to an efficiency improvement.
blocks.zh:
近期的工作通过改进后向通道,降低梯度,收紧瓦片界限来加速3DGS,并实现引信优化[38,6,47,15,12].
我们以这些想法为基础进行在线爆裂, 但从光栅化的界限到有界β内核。
特别是高斯断接对低通性固体内核无效,使得β特异性绑定成为除提高效率外的正确性要求.

blocks.en:
Monocular and multi-view depth predictors are commonly used to initialize or regularize radiance-field reconstruction [ 55 , 33 , 54 ] ; for example, Meuleman et al . [ 42 ] combine aligned monocular depth with guided MVS.
Uncertainty is often estimated post-hoc or used for view selection [ 11 , 24 ] .
We instead incorporate uncertainty directly into the online primitive lifecycle: agreement between independent depth estimates and geometric observability determine the primitive’s opacity and shape, while the evolving shape field provides a live confidence representation.
blocks.zh:
单景和多景深度预测器通常用于初始化或规范辐射地重建[55,33,54];例如,Meuleman等. [42]结合了对齐的单景深度和被引导的MVS.
不确定性往往被估算为后热或用于取景[11,24].
相反,我们直接将不确定性纳入在线原始生命周期:独立深度估计和几何可观察性之间的一致决定了原始人的不透明性和外形,而正在演变的外形场则提供了活性的信心代表。

blocks.en: 3 Preliminaries: Online 3DGS
blocks.zh: 3 初步:在线 3DGS

blocks.en:
Online 3DGS systems [ 42 , 30 ] reconstruct an RGB stream incrementally: each incoming frame is registered, used to spawn new primitives, and followed by a short optimization burst before the next keyframe.
In i3DGS [ 40 ] , registration matches each frame against previously registered keyframes using place recognition and learned feature matching [ 1 , 46 , 34 ] , initializes the pose with PnP/RANSAC, and performs local bundle adjustment over a covisibility graph, all running in tens of milliseconds per frame.
blocks.zh:
Online 3DGS系统 [42, 30] 递增地重建出一串RGB流:每个被接入的相框被注册,用来产出新的原始相,然后在下一个相框之前进行短暂的优化爆发.
在i3DGS [40]中,注册与之前已注册的密钥帧相匹配,使用位置识别和学到的特征匹配[1,46,34],以PnP/RANSAC来初始化姿势,并用可视化图来进行本地捆绑调整,每帧均以数十毫秒的速度运行.

blocks.en:
After registration, pixels with local image detail are sampled and lifted to 3D using available multi-view and monocular depth cues [ 42 , 40 , 30 ] .
The samples are instantiated as low-opacity, translucent isotropic Gaussians, followed by a short optimization burst of only a few dozen iterations.
Crucially, these online systems do not perform the clone/split densification or opacity resets used by offline 3DGS, nor the long per-keyframe mapping and final refinement of Gaussian SLAM [ 39 ] : primitives are spawned once and then retained, making their initialization critical.
blocks.zh:
注册后,将带有本地图像细节的像素进行采样并使用可用的多视图和单极深度提示[42,40,30]提升到3D.
标本被即时化为低不透明,半透明等地高斯人,而后短时间优化爆发出只有几十个迭代.
关键是,这些在线系统不执行下线3DGS使用的克隆/分解密度或不透明重排,也不执行高斯SLAMM的长长每键帧映射和最终改进:原始人一次被产出后被保留,使其初始化至关重要.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
Our method reconstructs a primitive-based radiance field online from an unordered stream of RGB images.
We adopt the pose-estimation backbone of Meuleman et al. [ 40 ] , but redesign the primitive and its lifecycle.
In the spawn-per-view, short-burst regime, positions receive too little optimization to recover from poor initialization, while longer optimization overfits already-seen keyframes.
We therefore make confidence explicit in the primitive representation: each primitive can be either a soft probe or a self-supporting surface patch, and primitives are later relocated from unused capacity to image-space error hotspots.
An overview of our method can be found in Fig. 2 .

我们的方法从一个无序的RGB图像流在线重建出一个以原始为基础的光场.
我们采用了Meuleman等人的假设式估计支柱。 [40],但重新设计原始及其生命周期。
在产卵-per-view-short-burst制度中,位置得到的优化太少,无法从不良初始化中恢复,而更长时间的优化超乎已见键框.
因此,我们明确了对原始代表的信心:每个原始人可以是软探测器,也可以是自收自支的地表补丁,而原始人后来被从未使用的能力迁移到图像空间误差热点.

blocks.en: 4.4 Error-Driven Incremental Relocation

blocks.en:
The overall amount of new detail that can be added per keyframe is limited, and offline clone/split heuristics require longer optimization.
Instead, inspired by the relocation mechanism of 3DGS-MCMC [ 28 ] , we introduce an error-targeted split: near-dead primitives are recycled by teleporting them to poorly reconstructed live primitives.

This rasterizer substantially reduces computation time.

To prevent redundant spawning, views observing primitives below one-quarter of their finest observed resolution are excluded from spawning and receive reduced update weights.

blocks.en:
We evaluate using the online protocols of Meuleman et al . [ 42 ] on three MipNeRF360 scenes (garden, counter, bonsai, marked with otf ) [ 3 ] , three TUM scenes [ 52 ] , and three StaticHikes captures [ 41 ] , with the same held-out views for evaluation.
We additionally evaluate on the 3DGS benchmark [ 26 , 3 , 17 , 29 ] and two large-scale captures, SmallCity [ 27 ] and CityWalk [ 42 ] .
We compare to methods including MonoGS [ 39 ] , S3PO-GS [ 4 ] , LongSplat [ 32 ] , On-The-Fly NVS [ 42 ] , i3DGS [ 40 ] , DROID-Splat [ 19 ] , CF-3DGS [ 10 ] , DepthAnything3 [ 33 ] , ARTDECO [ 30 ] , H3DGS [ 27 ] and Octree-GS [ 48 ] , as well as GLOMAP-based [ 44 , 51 ] offline references using Beta Splatting [ 36 ] and Faster-GS [ 12 ] .
We report PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and total time, averaging ours over five runs.

我们利用Meuleman et al.[42]的在线协议来评价三个MipNERF360场景(花园,柜台,bonsai,标有otf)[3],三个TUM场景[52],三个StaticHikes捕捉[41],有同样被搁置的评价观点.
我们额外评价了3DGS基准[26,3,17,29]和两个大规模捕获,SmallCity[27]和CityWalk[42].
我们比较了包括MonoGS [39],S3PO-GS [4],LongSplate [32],On-The-Fly NVS [42],i3DGS [40],DROID-Splate [19],CF-3DGS [10],深度3 [33],ARTECO [30],H3DGS [27]和Octree-GS [48]在内的方法,以及基于GLOMAP的以Beta Splate [36]和更快-GS [12]为基础的离线参考.
我们报告PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS 和总时间,平均我们超过5跑。

blocks.en:
Unless noted otherwise, experiments use an RTX 5090 (32 GB) and i9-14900KS with 64GB DDR4 RAM on Windows 11.
For methods requiring reduced input resolution, we follow [ 42 , 40 ] .
These results are reported in Appendix D .

blocks.en: 6.1 Results
blocks.zh: 6.1 结果

blocks.en:
Tab. 1 evaluates on the MipNeRF360 ( otf ), TUM, and StaticHikes scenes against pose-free and online baselines.
In this benchmark, our method outperforms our closest competitor i3DGS (except time on TUM), and is consistently among the strongest methods overall.
On MipNeRF360 ( otf ) and StaticHikes, we surpass competing pose-free methods on all three metrics while reducing computation time by up to 40 % 40\% .
On TUM, LongSplat has slightly better PSNR and SSIM, but takes roughly 50 × 50\times longer.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 1对MipNERF360(OTf),TUM,和StaticHikes的场景进行对照免装和在线基线的评价.
在这个基准中,我们的方法表现优于我们最接近的竞争对手i3DGS(TUM上的时间除外),并且始终是总体最强的方法之一.
MipNERF360 (otf) 和 StaticHikes 上, 我们超越了所有三种度量标准上相互竞争的无姿势方法,
在TUM上,LongSplat的PSNR和SSIM稍好一些,但需要约50×50\的时间.

blocks.en:
On the standard 3DGS benchmark ( Tabs. 2 and 6 ), we compare against BetaSplatting and FasterGS with sequential (fast) GLOMAP pose estimation (more expensive exhaustive setting in Tab. 16 ).
Our method is consistently the fastest, outperforming in SSIM and LPIPS on MipNeRF360 while remaining competitive on Tanks&Temples.
DeepBlending is more challenging; however replacing spherical-beta colors with SH improves our result by ∼ 0.3 \sim 0.3 dB ( Appendix E ).
On MipNeRF360, sequential matching can drop frames (e.g., bicycle), and metrics are therefore computed only on successfully registered views.
Against exhaustive-GLOMAP references ( Tab. 16 ), we remain competitive at 7k iterations, while 30k iterations achieve higher quality at ∼ 6 \sim 6 – 12 × 12\times our runtime and require the complete capture to be available beforehand.
blocks.zh:
在标准3DGS基准(Tabs. 2和6)上,我们与相继(快速)GLOMAP的BetaSplating和更快GS进行比较,得出了估计(在Tab. 16中更为昂贵的详尽设置)。
我们的方法在MIPNERF360的SSIM和LPIPS中始终是最快的,表现优于,同时在Tanks & Temples上仍然有竞争力.
DeepBlending更具有挑战性;然而,用 SH 来取代球形-β 颜色可以使我们的结果得到0.3\sim 0.3 dB(附录E)的改进。
在MipNERF360上,相继匹配可以放出帧(例如自行车),因此,度量衡只能根据成功注册的视图来计算.
相对于详尽无遗的GLOMAP参考文献(图16),我们在7k迭代时依然具有竞争力,而30k迭代则在 \\\ sim 6 — 12×12时达到更高的质量,需要提前获得完整的捕捉。

blocks.en:
Tab. 4 (top) ablates the components of our final configuration across the nine otf scenes.
Spherical-beta lobes (SB) provide a small quality and runtime improvement over SH, although SH is preferable on scenes such as Deep Blending ( Appendix E ).
Confidence-aware spawning, solidification, and zero-initialized lobes each improve reconstruction quality.
The fused rasterizer reduces runtime by about 16 % 16\% ; the 30-iteration optimization burst reduces from 287ms to 170ms ( Garden ).
Error-driven relocation yields a small runtime penalty of ∼ 6 % \sim 6\% but improves quality.
The opacity and scale regularizers further improve both runtime and quality, by feeding ineffective primitives into relocation.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 4 (top) 将我们最终配置的组件从9个OTf场景中分出.
球形-β叶片(SB)提供比SH小的质量和运行时间改进,虽然SH在"深波平起"(Deep Blending (附录E)等场景中更为可取.
信心意识的产卵、固化和零初始叶片都提高了重建质量。
引信的光栅将运行时间缩短了16% 16-%;30-穿透优化的爆发从287ms减少到了170ms(花园)。
错误驱动的迁移会导致6%的运行时间罚款,但提高了质量。
不透明性和规模化常态器通过将无效的原始人喂入迁移,进一步提高了运行时间和质量.

blocks.en:
Tab. 4 (bottom) evaluates the large-scale hierarchical setting ( Sec. 5 ).
Our moment-based merge consistently outperforms the opacity-weighted baseline by avoiding overly large parent primitives, with the largest gain on CityWalk ( + 2.27 +2.27 dB) where multiple hierarchy levels are required.
Resolution-aware weighting and error-based repair further improve quality by preventing late, low-resolution observations from degrading previously well-reconstructed regions.

我们的瞬间合并通过避免过于庞大的母体原始而持续地超过不透明加权基准,在CityWalk(+ 2.27 + 2.27 dB)上收益最大,而CityWalk需要多个等级级别.
分辨率-认识加权和基于误差的修复通过防止后期低分辨率观测使先前重建良好的区域退化,进一步提高了质量.

Tab. 5 evaluates the effect of different kernel choices on the nine otf scenes.
Beta kernels provide a small quality improvement over Gaussians, while also being faster due to their bounded support.
Together with confidence-aware spawning, they provide a + 0.2 +0.2 dB improvement.

它们与有自信的产卵一起,提供了+0.2+0.2分贝的改进.

blocks.en: 6.3 Quality During Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 6.3 重建期间的质量

blocks.en:
On the 3DGS benchmark, experiments show a remaining quality gap to fully optimized offline methods, suggesting that further improvements in online pose refinement [ 40 ] —orthogonal to our work—are a promising direction for closing the remaining gap.
The merge approximates out-of-band groups and the rendered contribution, and shuffled input can reduce quality.
Further promising directions include integration with VR [ 8 ] and using the confidence map for refinement [ 11 ] .

blocks.en:
We present an online reconstruction framework that redesigns the primitive lifecycle around the short optimization horizon of incremental capture.
Our bounded beta kernel encodes a continuous notion of solidity, observability-aware spawning initializes this confidence from geometric evidence, and error-driven relocation reallocates unused capacity to poorly explained regions.
Closed-form moment matching enables a shape-aware hierarchy, while bounded-support rasterization and fused optimization make the representation efficient for large-scale online reconstruction.
Together, these components yield faster and higher-quality reconstruction throughout capture, while turning the primitive shape field into a live confidence visualization.
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个在线重建框架,围绕增量捕捉的短暂优化前景重新设计原始生命周期。
我们的受限β内核编码了一个连续的固态概念,可观察性-可知性产能从几何证据中初始化了这种信心,而由错误驱动的迁移将未使用的能力重新分配给解释不周的地区.
封闭式瞬间匹配可以实现形状意识分级,而边框式支撑光栅化和引信优化则能使代表效率高地进行大规模在线重建.
这些组件合在一起,在整个捕捉过程中产生更快,质量更高的重建,同时将原始的外形场变成活性的信心可视化.

blocks.en: Appendix B Implementation Details & Startup
blocks.zh: 附录B 实施细节和启动

blocks.en:
The system is implemented in PyTorch 2.11/CUDA 12.8, with performance-critical stages implemented as custom GPU kernels.
Feature extraction uses XFeat [ 46 ] , matching combines mutual nearest neighbors with LighterGlue [ 34 ] , retrieval uses MixVPR [ 1 ] , and monocular depth priors use Depth Anything V2 [ 55 ] .
The pose-estimation and mapping stages follow the backbone of i3DGS [ 40 ] , including P3P/RANSAC, triangulation, and local bundle adjustment.
blocks.zh:
该系统由PyTorch 2.11/CUDA 12.8执行,性能关键阶段作为自定义的GPU内核执行.
地物取出使用XFeat [46],将相邻相邻的相邻相接相接相接为LighterGlue [34],取出使用MixVPR [1],而单相通深度前作使用深度Anything V2 [55].
平面估计和绘图阶段遵循了i3DGS [40] 的主干,包括P3P/RANSAC,三角化,以及本地捆绑调整.

blocks.en:
Rasterization uses our beta-kernel implementation of a FasterGS-style fused rasterizer [ 12 ] .
Forward quantities are recomputed during the backward pass, and the sparse Adam update and analytic regularizer gradients are applied directly to the optimizer state without materializing primitive gradients.
Spherical-beta colour parameters are stored compactly for the fused implementation, while exported models retain the standard SH-width layout for compatibility.

Rasterization使用我们的β-内核执行一种更快速的GS型有引信的光栅[12].
向后行走时会重算出前行量,而相去甚远的亚当更新与分析常态梯度直接被应用到最优化的状态,而不会实现原始梯度.
球形-β色参数为被引信执行而紧凑地存储,而导出模型则保留标准SH-width相容的布局.

Each keyframe performs one 30 30 -iteration optimization burst.
The bootstrap uses 8 8 keyframes, local BA operates on the 5 5 most similar keyframes, and the LoD hierarchy is rebuilt every 10 10 keyframes.
Inactive fine levels and keyframes beyond the active window are offloaded to host memory.
All reported timings include the online pose estimation, spawning, optimization, and hierarchy stages.

blocks.en:
Our method is designed for unordered image streams, so we evaluate the identical configuration on fixed random permutations of the input images ( Tab. 17 ).
On Garden , Counter , and Bonsai , shuffling changes PSNR by − 0.48 -0.48 , + 0.56 +0.56 , and − 2.50 -2.50 dB, respectively, with comparable registration rates.
It does, however, increase run-to-run variance, e.g. σ = 0.74 \sigma=0.74 dB for shuffled Bonsai versus 0.16 0.16 dB for the ordered stream.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法是针对无序图像流设计的,因此我们在输入图像的固定随机排列上评价相同的配置(Tab 17.).
在Garden、Counter和Bonsai, 刷新PSNR的登记率分别为−0.48-0.48、+0.56+0.56和 2.50-2.50分贝。
然而,它确实增加了跑入跑入跑的相差分数,例如:对被冲走的邦赛(Bonsai)而言,被冲走的邦赛(Bonsai)的相差分数为相差0.16分之16分之一。

blocks.en:
On fr1/desk , shuffling reduces PSNR by 0.84 0.84 dB but improves SSIM and LPIPS ( → 0.870 0.844\!\to\!0.870 and → 0.179 0.209\!\to\!0.179 ), with essentially
unchanged registration.
Runtime increases by about 1.5 × 1.5\times as temporal adjacency is lost and more frames require shelving and retrieval.
At the same time, random ordering provides a more diverse bootstrap, avoiding the poorly conditioned ordered start observed on this sequence.
blocks.zh:
在fr1/桌面上,洗牌将PSNR减少0.84 0.84 dB,但改进了SSIM和LPIPS(~0.870 0.844/!\to!!0.870和~0.179 0.209\!),基本具备了0.179.
登记不变。
运行时间增加约1.5×1.5\时,因为时间相接性丢失了,而更多的帧需要被套取和取回.
同时,随机订购提供了更多样化的靴子陷阱,避免了在这个序列上观测到条件差的有序起步.

blocks.en: Overall, the results confirm that the reconstruction does not require temporal ordering: failed sequential matches fall back to shelf-based bootstrap selection and retrieval over previously registered keyframes.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,结果证实重建不需要时间命令:失败的相继匹配会回到基于架式的靴子圈选择和取回之前注册的键框.
